requestedText: Add module-local regression tests for the provider-agnostic Semantic Message Splitter interface.

evidence: The module-local tests execute deterministic in-memory Markdown cases and do not load runtime modules, files, network resources, or providers.
The test source has no production or external consumer; it verifies only the local splitter boundary.
The test source adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, retry, or provider integration.
The Contract requires module-local splitter tests and excludes provider integration, shared coverage policy, and unrelated architecture-test changes.
